- **AC-SE-26 (lint/auto) Cue purity (SE-25).** GIVEN Suit's hook, mutators and read views, WHEN scanned, THEN none imports or reads a Sanity, Attention or `PERCEPTION_OUT` symbol and the block has no believed or displayed field; GIVEN a replay with a mutated sanity block, THEN every cue output is identical.
- **AC-SE-27 (review) Classification (SE-26).** GIVEN Visual/Audio Requirements and UI Requirements, WHEN every player-facing value is listed, THEN each is tagged with exactly one of the six SE-26 classes (closed-list cue, breath-family cue, on-sprite anchor, reading, physical result, TRUTH-class bit) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)* matching its SE-26 row; the four amendments to the Graph's list (rime, stagger / walk-only / DOWNED, seam jet, HEAVY back-frame) appear in Cross-References as landed. The Graph's consequence-channel list carries the four amendments (2026-10-27; OQ-9 answered), so this criterion no longer blocks on the Graph; it may not be marked passed on the strength of this GDD's own classification.
- **AC-SE-28a (manual) No screen effect, atmosphere states (SE-27; Visual/Feel) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.** GIVEN the debug console forcing `band_o2`, `band_p` and rung on a seat, WHEN each of THIN, HYPOXIC, ANOXIC, LOW and DECOMP is captured at the minimum evidence set of zooms `k` in {1, `k_auto`, `k_auto` + 2} (owned by the Avatar Presenter and Art story; the full sweep of every integer zoom in [1, `k_auto` + 2] is run once at art lock) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, THEN no vignette, tunnel, blur or false state appears; files `AC-SE-28a_<state>_k<k>.png` in `production/qa/evidence/`, with a sign-off line from the art-director or creative-director appended to the evidence index.
- **AC-SE-28b (manual) No screen effect, thermal states (SE-27).** GIVEN the same console, WHEN each of FROST, FREEZING, HOT and SCORCH is captured at the minimum evidence set of zooms (AC-SE-28a) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, THEN no frost overlay or edge tint appears, and HOT and SCORCH show no body cue of any kind; files `AC-SE-28b_<state>_k<k>.png`, with a sign-off line.
- **AC-SE-28c (manual) No screen effect, rung states (SE-27).** GIVEN the same console, WHEN STRAINED, CRITICAL and FAILED are captured at the minimum evidence set of zooms (AC-SE-28a) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, THEN no screen-space effect appears; files `AC-SE-28c_<rung>_k<k>.png`, with a sign-off line.
- **AC-SE-29 (auto) Mass cue (SE-28, D.6).** GIVEN the start kit, THEN `cue_load` 0; GIVEN `part_duct_coupling` x4 and `part_cable_splice` x4 stowed (5,600 g, at or above `WEIGHT_MEDIUM_G`), 1; GIVEN additionally `part_hull_plate` stowed (at or above `WEIGHT_HEAVY_G`), 2; for carried in {none, MEDIUM `mod_door_motor`, HEAVY `mod_scrubber`} and stowed in {LIGHT, MEDIUM, HEAVY} the nine outputs are 0,1,2 / 1,1,2 / 2,2,2; `STOWED_CUE_FLOOR_CLASS` HEAVY makes stowed MEDIUM contribute 0; in-hand tools and reserved parts never count (`reserve_stowed` lowers `cue_load` on the same run). The test reads the class boundary from the registry and hard-codes no gram figure.
- **AC-SE-42a (spike) Blind audio protocol (SE-28; Vertical Slice A precondition) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.** GIVEN two clips, load breath (deep, creak, at the air class's own rate) and thin-air breath (shallow, fast, no creak), WHEN at least 30 naive listeners (never exposed to the design) each classify each clip blind, in random order, with the clips counterbalanced, THEN the raw classifications are retained as a CSV in `production/qa/evidence/`.
- **AC-SE-42b (spike) Blind audio threshold (SE-28).** GIVEN those results, WHEN each clip's identification rate is computed, THEN the observed rate is at least 90 % **and** the one-sided 95 % Wilson lower bound is at least 75 % (at N = 30 that needs at least 28 of 30; the earlier 18 of 20 had a lower bound near 70 % and could not tell 90 % from 75 %); failure blocks the Vertical Slice A phantom-salvage check, not the MVP.
- **AC-SE-30 (auto) Reading wrap (SE-29).** GIVEN a stub Filter that wraps `true_value` for the five keys, WHEN it returns false values, THEN the HUD value changes and no body cue, `locomotion_cap` or overlay visibility changes; GIVEN the MVP default, THEN every key returns the true value.
- **AC-SE-45a (auto) Cue levels (D.10) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.** GIVEN a table of `(band_t, rung, thermal_load)` inputs, WHEN `suit_cue_levels` runs, THEN `cue_cold` is 3 / 2 / 1 / 0 as defined, `cue_fog` is `min(rung_breath, 2)`, `charge_band` is 0 / 1 / 2, `carried_class` is 0 with nothing carried and 1 + the weight class otherwise (0..3), `cue_load` per D.6, and the marks are set at CRITICAL (and the cell warn edge) but never at STRAINED; the heat side yields no body overlay and no closed-list body cue (its fan whirr is reading-class, SE-26; exception E2).
- **AC-SE-45b (auto) Cold side is gated on the band (D.10).** GIVEN `thermal_load` −2000 (rung 1), WHEN `band_t` is HOT or SCORCH, THEN `cold_side` is false and `cue_cold` is 0 (no rime, no shiver); WHEN `band_t` is COOL, THEN `cold_side` is true and `cue_cold` is 2; GIVEN a load that crosses 0 to positive in a HOT room, THEN `cold_side` stays false; the rung and the cap are unchanged by the gating.
- **AC-SE-45c (auto) Breath cue tuple and edge counter (D.10).** GIVEN `breath_src` ROOM, RESERVE, GASP and NONE, THEN `cue_breath` is `{src, air_class, pace_step}` with `air_class` 0 / 1 / 2 from D.1 and `pace_step` `min(rung_breath, 2)`; GIVEN a source change ROOM to RESERVE, THEN `breath_src_change_seq` increases by exactly 1 on that run and by 0 on every other run; GIVEN a snapshot and restore, THEN the counter is unchanged and no edge is derived.
- **AC-SE-45d (auto) Charge advisory (D.5, D.10).** GIVEN `cell_ticks` at `CELL_ADVISE_S` x `TICK_RATE` (7,200), THEN `charge_advise` is true and `charge_band` is OK; at `CELL_WARN_S` x `TICK_RATE` + 1 (1,201) true; at 1,200, `charge_advise` is false and `charge_band` is WARN; the advisory raises no mark, no audio cue and no `SHARED_SUMMARY` field.
- **AC-SE-31a (manual) O2 numeral (SE-30; UI) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*.** GIVEN the build and a THIN room set to a known `p_o2`, WHEN the critical strip is captured in OK, STRAINED and CRITICAL, THEN the ambient O2 numeral equals the seat's compartment `p_o2` in dkPa while the source is not RESERVE, and the dial shows the suit O2 while the source is RESERVE; retained screenshots (UI, BLOCKING).
- **AC-SE-31b (manual) Mark anchors (SE-30, D.10; UI) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*.** GIVEN the suit panel and strip captured at each rung, THEN the strip mark appears on the breath dial when the breath rung is 2 whatever `breath_src` is, `mark_reserve` shows the reserve glyph's mark only while the rung is 2 or more and the source is RESERVE, the mark is beside the warmth glyph at warmth rung 2, beside the integrity glyph at integrity rung 2, beside the charge glyph at the cell warn edge, and nowhere at rung 1; the count is never above six including the alarm; retained screenshots (UI, BLOCKING).
- **AC-SE-31c (manual) Alarm mark and dormant charge (SE-30; UI) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings; re-review)*.** GIVEN `suit.alarm` 1, THEN the sixth mark shows and is not rung-based; GIVEN the dormant `CELL_ENABLED` 0 configuration, THEN the charge reading is absent; retained screenshots (UI, BLOCKING).
- **AC-SE-31d (manual) Hand rail and scale (SE-30; UI) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*.** GIVEN the hand rail captured with and without a carried module, THEN no weight readout, inventory or per-part count exists, and the HUD is unchanged in size between two world zoom levels; retained screenshots (UI, BLOCKING).
- **AC-SE-53a to 53f (manual) Body-cue evidence (Visual/Feel, lead sign-off) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.** *Shared procedure.* GIVEN the build and the debug console, WHEN the cue is captured on each of the five facings at the minimum evidence set of zooms {1, `k_auto`, `k_auto` + 2} (owned by the Avatar Presenter and Art story; the full zoom sweep is run once at art lock) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*, shown against a paired capture of the same facing with the state forced off, THEN the cue is present only in its true state; one contact sheet per cue (facings in a grid) in `production/qa/evidence/`, and a sign-off line appended to the evidence index. The six criteria differ only in the cue: **53a** rime (two levels), **53b** visor fog (two levels), **53c** shiver (idle only, absent while moving), **53d** the seam jet, **53e** the HEAVY back-frame, **53f** the stagger frame.
- **AC-SE-77 (lint) No reading bypass (SE-29).** GIVEN the HUD and every consumer outside Suit, WHEN scanned, THEN the five readings are read only through `true_value` and never from the `view()` reading fields.
- **AC-SE-78 (auto) Breath cue separability (SE-28, D.10).** GIVEN HEAVY `cue_load` in THIN air, THEN `breath_step` equals the value for the same air with `cue_load` 0 and the creak layer is on; GIVEN `cue_load` HEAVY versus 0 with an identical Controller input, THEN walking speed (`V_WALK`) and the noise class emitted are unchanged.
- **AC-SE-91a (review) Accessibility witness coverage, the table half (SE-26, D.10; OQ-40 ruled) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*.** GIVEN the D.10 normative cue table, WHEN read, THEN every body-cue row has a non-audio witness or appears on the user-accepted exception list (E1 stowed MEDIUM load, E2 heat STRAINED to CRITICAL), or on the delegated exception E3 (cold accrual onset, OQ-51, R21), every `cap.suit.*` id in the table exists in the captions policy (AA-41), and any tactile channel is driven only by the table's rows. The exception list and the caption ids were accepted on 2026-10-27, so this half is judged now.
- **AC-SE-91b (review) Accessibility document half.** GIVEN `design/accessibility-requirements.md`, WHEN it exists, THEN it carries E1, E2 and E3 (E3 by delegated ruling R21), the caption-id contract and the haptics clause. **Status: NOT ASSESSED** only because the document does not exist yet (it is to be authored later with `/ux-design accessibility` and is not created by this GDD); never PASS.
- **AC-SE-93 (auto) `suit.alarm` (SE-29; OQ-37 ruled) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*.** GIVEN `alarm_sections()` empty, THEN `true_value(suit.alarm, player_id)` is 0; GIVEN it contains a section of the seat's body, THEN the value is 1 from the first read after that Graph run; GIVEN it contains only a section of another body, THEN 0; GIVEN the DOOR-BREACH fixture on a derelict body, THEN 0 up to step 124 and 1 from step 125 *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*; GIVEN a stub Filter that corrupts every lie-capable key, THEN `suit.alarm` is returned unwrapped (TRUTH-class, no HR-5 slots) and no body cue or cap changes; the `suit.state` snapshot contains no alarm field (derived on read, never saved); the bit names no loop or place; with all five rung and charge marks showing plus the alarm the mark count is six and no more.

### G. Seams, save, determinism (SE-31 to SE-39)

- **AC-SE-32 (lint) No stimulus push (SE-31).** GIVEN Suit's source, WHEN scanned, THEN no call reaches an Attention intake.
- **AC-SE-33 (auto) Pause (SE-32).** GIVEN a paused kernel, WHEN `equip_tool` or any Suit mutator is submitted, THEN it is rejected and no counter changes.
- **AC-SE-34a (review) Autosave soft gate (SE-33; OQ-13 ruled) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings)*.** GIVEN the Save/Load GDD, WHEN read, THEN it adopts the ruled package: a bound seat's `vitals_state` of CRITICAL or worse is a third soft-gate input (capped at `AUTOSAVE_MAX_DEFER_TICKS`, then RISKY, no glyph) also applied to `quit_risky`; `loop_hit` also fires when `T_downed − g_r.T < W_MIN_WARNING_S × TICK_RATE` (600 ticks); a post-DOWNED refractory of 600 ticks applies; and its draft criteria AC-SL-128 and AC-SL-129 are promoted. **Status:** the ruled branch is the only branch; Save/Load's text carries the package (verified by grep at the re-review, 2026-10-27), so the review runs against it, with NOT ASSESSED only for the unconfirmed AC-SL-128 / 129 promotion, never PASS from this GDD's own text *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*; it blocks the Save/Load stories `autosave_gate` and `generation_select`, not the Suit story.
- **AC-SE-34b (auto) Suit's half of the gate (SE-33).** GIVEN a seat whose worst rung is 2 or 3, WHEN `view(player_id).vitals_state` is read after the run's commit, THEN it is 2 or 3; GIVEN a worst rung of 0 or 1, THEN 0 or 1; the value is derived on read, never saved, and equals the maximum of the three persisted rungs.
- **AC-SE-35 (auto) SL-15 round trip (SE-34, SE-38) *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*.** GIVEN a populated four-seat block, WHEN it is snapshotted, restored and snapshotted again, THEN the two snapshots are byte-equal (restore idempotence) including `rung_*`, `hold_*`, `exo_pending` and `reserved`; `post_restore` rebuilds every `prev_*` so no spurious valve click or stagger fires; an unsupported version, an out-of-range field, a stowed count over `stack_max`, an unknown `def_id`, a bad `beam_shape` and an unbound seat each fail with their named `SUIT_RESTORE_*` reason and never clamp; a seat carrying `['mod_scrubber',1,5800,6000,S,0]` and stowing `['part_pipe_fitting',2,0,0,0,0]` round-trips byte-equal *(Amended 2026-10-28 — cross-GDD fix)*.
- **AC-SE-36a (auto) Pod run (SE-35, SE-3; D60; delegated ruling R6) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings; re-review, delegated ruling R6)*.** GIVEN a pod hop with `loco_state` IN_POD, the beam off, a full reserve (270,000), `thermal_load` 0 and a nominal leg of `n_pod` = `HOP_LEG_TICKS` + `ARRIVE_SETTLE_TICKS` = 945 ticks whose first pod tick is 3 mod 6 (so `N_lo` = floor(945 / 6) = 157 runs, remainder 3 carried, D.1), WHEN the leg runs, THEN no `draw_air` is issued, `pending_draw_mgu` is 0, `breath_starved` stays 0 and no GASP cue fires; `breath_src` is RESERVE from the first run and `breath_src_change_seq` rises by exactly 1 on entry and by exactly 1 on arrival (the valve click plays on those two edges only, never per run); the reserve falls by exactly 157 x `R_BREATH` = 47,100 mGU to 222,900 (the oracle is written as `RESERVE_MAX_MGU − N_lo × R_BREATH`, with N_lo computed from the registry values; with a first pod tick of 0 mod 6 the count is `N_hi` = 158 and the reserve is 222,600, so a test that does not pin the phase asserts the range [222,600, 222,900]); the breath rung is 1 throughout (the reserve stays above `RESERVE_WARN_MGU`); `thermal_load` stays 0; GIVEN the beam lit, THEN `cell_ticks` falls by `N_lo` x `GRAPH_STEP_TICKS` = 942; GIVEN a seat boarding at `thermal_load` −3900, THEN it falls below 3,700 after 17 runs; AND on the first run after the leg `cid` differs from `POD_CID`, the window re-anchors and no `stagger` is submitted.
- **AC-SE-36b (auto) Exposed (SE-3, SE-35).** GIVEN a seat in a NORMAL room and `room_at` answering NONE with `loco_state` not IN_POD (fault-injected, BDY-29), WHEN the next runs execute, THEN the seat is EXPOSED to the EXTERIOR (index 3 by rule), the switch is a compartment change, zero `stagger` submissions are made on that run and the following runs, and everything keeps running (AC-SE-5).
- **AC-SE-36c (auto) Pull (SE-35).** GIVEN a DECOMP entry, WHEN the run executes, THEN the DECOMP cue level is set and Suit makes no displacement call of any kind (the seat's position delta caused by Suit is 0).
- **AC-SE-36d (auto) Window boundary (D.12).** GIVEN a synthetic trace in one compartment with index 0 on run `m` and index 2 on run `m` + 9, `m` + 10 and `m` + 11 (three separate traces), WHEN each is stepped at `STAGGER_WINDOW_TICKS` 60, THEN the `stagger` submission counts are 1, 1 and 0; AND the same pattern holds for index 1 then 3, and at `STAGGER_WINDOW_TICKS` 30 and 120 with the boundary at `m` + 5 and `m` + 20.
- **AC-SE-36e (auto) Step sizes and continuing falls (D.12).** GIVEN one-band steps 0-1, 1-2 and 2-3, THEN zero submissions each; GIVEN 0-2, 1-3 and 0-3 inside the window, THEN exactly one each; GIVEN 0-2 then 3 inside the window, THEN one in total; GIVEN 0-2, a recovery to 1, then 3 inside the window, THEN two; AND on the locked DOOR-BREACH harness the trigger submits zero (Example 1), the breach's stagger arriving only through the ladder's cap edge.
- **AC-SE-36f (auto) Crossing and restore (D.12, SE-38).** GIVEN a seat that crosses a door into a room already two bands lower, THEN zero submissions; GIVEN a snapshot taken at `p_age0` 3 with index 0 sampled and restored, WHEN the trace resumes with index 2 five runs later, THEN the `stagger` is submitted on the same run as in an uninterrupted session and not on the restore run itself; GIVEN a saved `p_age0` of `STAGGER_WINDOW_RUNS` + 2, THEN the restore fails `SUIT_RESTORE_FIELD_RANGE` and live state is untouched.
- **AC-SE-94 (auto) Pod reserve cost and lethality bounds (D.1 pod derivation; SE-35; D60; delegated ruling R6) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — user rulings; re-review, delegated ruling R6)*.** GIVEN legs of 945, 975, 2,265 and 2,400 ticks (run counts `N_lo` / `N_hi` of 157 / 158, 162 / 163, 377 / 378 and 400 / 400, each computed by the test as floor and ceil of `n_pod` / `GRAPH_STEP_TICKS`) and boarding reserves R0, WHEN stepped through D.1 to D.3, THEN the reserve falls `d` per run (300 mGU, 450 on a leaking suit, clamped at 0), `breath_starved` is 0 and no GASP cue fires; for each N in {`N_lo`, `N_hi`} CRITICAL is reached iff k0 + `HOLD_12` <= N and FAILED is reached iff max(k0 + `HOLD_12`, k1) + `HOLD_23(breath)` <= N, with k0 = ceil((R0 − `RESERVE_WARN_MGU`) / d) for R0 above `RESERVE_WARN_MGU` (else 0) and k1 = ceil(R0 / d), all computed from registry values and never from a literal (to within one run of the D.3 run-order convention); spot values from the D.1 table at `N_hi`: on 945 ticks CRITICAL iff R0 <= 107,400 (d 300) and iff R0 <= 116,100 (d 450); on 2,400 ticks FAILED iff R0 <= 75,000 (d 300) and iff R0 <= 112,500 (d 450); on any leg of at most 1,494 ticks (`N_hi` below 250) FAILED is never reached for any R0 in 0..`RESERVE_MAX_MGU` (swept in steps of `R_BREATH`) at either `d`; from R0 = 0 the rung is 1 on the first run, 2 at run 100 and 3 at run 250 (exactly `HOLD_12` + `HOLD_23(breath)`), at least `SUIT_MIN_WARNING_S` x `RUNS_PER_S` = 200 runs from the first cue; a seat that reaches FAILED in the pod is handed to the Controller's DOWNED and DEAD rules with no Suit special case (integration with the Controller, driven by a stub until its story lands).
- **AC-SE-37 (auto) `SHARED_SUMMARY` (SE-36).** GIVEN the replication hint, WHEN the summary is built, THEN it carries exactly `{locomotion_cap, vitals_state, cue_cold, cue_fog, cue_load, beam_shape, charge_band, carried_class}` and no reserve value, tool charge or integrity number.
- **AC-SE-38a (auto) Determinism (SE-37) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — design review)*.** GIVEN two runs of the same seed and command trace, WHEN `state_hash` is compared, THEN they are equal.
- **AC-SE-38b (lint) No nondeterminism or scene tree (SE-37).** GIVEN Suit's hook, mutators and block, WHEN scanned, THEN they contain no RNG, wall clock, `delta` or `Node`.
- **AC-SE-38c (auto) Integer width (SE-37) *(Amended 2026-10-27 — re-review)*.** GIVEN every block field and every intermediate named in D.1 to D.12, WHEN the formulas are evaluated through a checked-int32 wrapper at the registered range limits (the same evaluation as AC-SE-83b), THEN no value exceeds 2^31 - 1 and none is negative where the formula's range is non-negative.
- **AC-SE-39 (auto/lint) Guard-rail test (SE-40).** GIVEN every published mutator, WHEN each is called, THEN only `suit.state` changes; AND the only command type Suit registers is `equip_tool`; the retired names (`consume_glowstick`, `stow`, `unstow`, `has_glowstick`, `equipped_tool`, `apply_harm`) appear nowhere.
